slug: 2024-01-01 Ghana national data exchange case study (Digital Impact Alliance)

facts.fact: DIAL says Ghana's national data-exchange hub (eGIF, launched 2009) stalled on funding and unclear mandates, and that in its absence the Ghana.gov payments portal became the de facto vehicle for streamlining data exchange.
DIAL says the Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation re-issued bids for a National Data Exchange Hub in 2019 and 2022, with status unclear.
